title: Bag of Bricks - Brown 12
descriptionHtml:
Brown — colour 12

The everyday earth tone. Brown covers hair, timber, animal coats and tree trunks — the unglamorous work that most natural scenes depend on. Steady, mid-weight, endlessly useful.

Works well with: Dark Brown 30, Toffee 29, Nougat 32

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Brown bricks (colour 12) for Memobrick mosaics. An everyday earth tone for hair, wood, animals and grounded natural scenes.
